name: Bystander
summary: An ordinary person on the street: hostage, witness, or someone to rescue. Swap the Expertise for any job or hobby.

name: Reporter
summary: A journalist chasing the big story, often right into the middle of a super-powered fight. Works for any professional with new Expertise picks.
book_note: Book totals Defenses as 2, but its printed Will 2 comes entirely from AWE 2 (no purchased defenses), so the true total is 28.

name: Scientist
summary: A specialist in one field, from archaeology to zoology; useful as a professor, consultant, or kidnapping target.

name: Government Agent
summary: A federal agent or intelligence officer with broad training, a badge, and a sidearm.

name: Police Chief
summary: The head of a city or county police force; a dedicated public servant or a politician on the take.
book_note: Book totals Abilities as 14 and Advantages as 2, but its abilities sum to 9 ranks (18 points) and Connected + Equipment 2 is 3 points, so the true total is 55.

name: Police Officer
summary: A uniformed beat cop. Detectives and plainclothes officers trade some combat training for Investigation and social skills.
book_note: Book lists PL4, but Parry 4 + Toughness 6 (with the vest) = 10 exceeds the PL4 limit of 8; listed here at PL5 with the book stats unchanged.

name: SWAT Officer
summary: A tactical police officer trained for squad assaults, hostage rescue, and containing metahuman criminals.

name: Militant
summary: A trained fighter for a cause, from militia member to terrorist bomb-maker, ready to kill or die for it.

equipment.name: Other Gear (GM's choice)
equipment.effect: 9 equipment points chosen for the mission

name: Soldier
summary: An enlisted infantry soldier with a rifle, armor, and drilled teamwork. Officers and specialists add skills.

name: Crime Lord
summary: A boss who clawed up through the ranks and now runs the rackets. Weak in a fight, dangerous through money and connections.

name: Criminal
summary: A run-of-the-mill career crook: burglar, fence, car thief, or stick-up artist. Shuffle the skills to specialize.

name: Gang Leader
summary: The boss of a small street gang. Add Deception, Persuasion, and Expertise for a bigger crew.

name: Street Informant
summary: The eyes and ears of the underworld: knows who is doing what, for a price.

name: Thug
summary: Hired muscle: mugger, gangster, or a super-villain's goon. Also works for bouncers and cheap security.
book_note: Book lists PL2, but Parry 2 + Toughness 3 (with the jacket) = 5 exceeds the PL2 limit of 4, so it is listed at PL3 with the book stats unchanged. The book also adds its totals to 30, but 14 + 2 + 13 + 2 = 31.

name: Robot
summary: A basic armored robot following simple programmed orders, typical of a villain's mechanical army.

name: Gang Member
summary: A young street-gang soldier with a knife, a cheap pistol, and something to prove.

name: Mob Enforcer
summary: A broad-shouldered leg-breaker who collects debts and sends messages with brass knuckles.

name: Bodyguard
summary: A professional protector in a dark suit who watches the crowd and throws himself in front of the bullet.

name: Street Martial Artist
summary: An underground fight-club champion or dojo dropout who takes on all comers with fast hands and feet.

name: Hacker
summary: A keyboard wizard who cracks security systems, forges records, and sells data to the highest bidder.

name: Getaway Driver
summary: The wheel artist who keeps the engine running and loses the cops in traffic.

equipment.name: Car
equipment.effect: Vehicle: Large, Strength 5, Speed 5, Defense 8, Toughness 8

name: Security Guard
summary: A night watchman or mall cop with a nightstick, a flashlight, and very little desire to be a hero.

name: Riot Police
summary: An armored officer in a riot line, trained to hold ground and use batons and tear gas together with the squad.

equipment.name: Gas Mask
equipment.effect: Feature 1 (immune to eye and lung irritants)

name: Special Forces Operative
summary: An elite commando trained for raids, rescues, and covert strikes deep in hostile territory.

name: Sniper
summary: A patient marksman who can wait for hours and hit a target from half a mile away.

name: Mercenary
summary: A soldier for hire working for whoever pays: warlords, corporations, or super-villains.

name: Pirate
summary: A modern sea raider who boards ships from a fast skiff with a rifle and a machete.

name: Bounty Hunter
summary: A relentless tracker who brings in fugitives, preferably alive, with a shotgun, bolas, and a stun gun.

name: Secret Agent
summary: A polished field operative fluent in languages, lies, and lethal force, working deep cover for an intelligence service.

equipment.name: Suppressor
equipment.effect: Subtle 1 on a firearm (DC 20 to hear)

name: Ninja
summary: A black-clad clan warrior who strikes from the shadows with sword and shuriken and vanishes again.

name: Assassin
summary: A professional killer who studies the target, picks the moment, and is gone before the body hits the floor.

equipment.name: Suppressor
equipment.effect: Subtle 1 on a firearm (DC 20 to hear)

name: Cultist
summary: A robed believer who chants at midnight rituals and will fight fanatically for the cult's dark master.

name: Cult Leader
summary: A charismatic high priest who has bargained with something from beyond for a little real power.

powers.name: Unholy Command
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled

name: Lab Technician
summary: A mad scientist's lab-coated assistant who keeps the death ray calibrated and flees when the heroes burst in.

name: Jumpsuit Henchman
summary: A color-coded goon in the villain's matching jumpsuit, armed with a ray gun and a lot of enthusiasm.

name: Alien Soldier
summary: An armored infantry trooper of an invading star empire, carrying a plasma rifle and seeing in infrared.

name: Robot Drone
summary: A hovering surveillance drone with a built-in laser, deployed in flocks to watch, chase, and harass.

name: Combat Robot
summary: A heavily armored war machine with an arm blaster and crushing fists, built to fight heroes head-on.

name: Android Infiltrator
summary: A synthetic person with lifelike skin and a programmed personality, built to replace someone important.

powers.name: Internal Radio
powers.detail: Internal radio link to its creators

construct_note: Automaton that has bought up its absent Intellect and Presence (starting from -5) per DCA ch. 7, giving it a programmed personality.

name: Giant Mech
summary: A building-sized war robot with jump jets, a shoulder missile pod, and an arm cannon, rampaging through downtown.
construct_note: The engine does not add Growth to an absent Stamina, so the mech's size-based Toughness is bought as Protection. Toughness 21 = Growth 12 (constructs add Growth to Toughness) + Protection 9.

name: Security Turret
summary: A ceiling- or wall-mounted autocannon with motion sensors that guards a vault or corridor.
construct_note: Immobile construct: absent Strength and Agility (plus absent Fighting and Presence); it can aim with Dexterity but cannot move.
